reviewItem.question: Does "The Helm options `hubble.tls.server.cert`, `hubble.tls.server.key`, `hubble.relay.tls.client.cert`, `hubble.relay.tls.client.key`, `hubble.relay.tls.server.cer…" mean a change to helm-value:cilium|path=hubble.tls.server.cert (deprecated)?

proposed.statement: The Helm options hubble.tls.server.cert, hubble.tls.server.key, hubble.relay.tls.client.cert, hubble.relay.tls.client.key, hubble.relay.tls.server.cert, hubble.relay.tls.server.key, hubble.ui.tls.client.cert, and hubble.ui.tls.client.key are deprecated in favor of the associated existingSecret options and will be removed in a future release.
